names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιοι Έξι Πατέρες», with the rank word Άγιοι left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

The same page adds a second Greek day and a second rank: «Η μνήμη τους επαναλαμβάνεται στις 4 Ιανουαρίου και αναφέρονται σαν έξι Μάρτυρες» — their memory is repeated on 4 January, where they are referred to as six Martyrs (https://www.saint.gr/26/saint.aspx). One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row records the day page read, 15 Ιανουαρίου.
